title: How Language Models Differ in Redistributing Attention-Head Activity Under Serial Demand
abstract: arXiv:2609.36221v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The way a model distributes activity over each layer's attention heads offers a coarse view of how it routes information through depth; how this changes with the task is part of what a mechanistic account must explain. Holding prompt length fixed, we vary how many serial steps a task demands and measure, in every layer of 17 open-weight models, whether activity concentrates on a few heads or spreads across many as demand rises. Both occur: in most models, layers just before mid-depth concentrate activity and later layers spread it. Models differ in where and how strongly this happens. The Qwen2.5 base models from 0.5B to 7B, for example, spread less than the average model in every task and concentrate activity in parts of their second half, where Llama models from 1B to 8B and OLMo-2 spread; the contrast largely holds between Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen2.5-72B, which have the same number of layers and heads. These differences are reproducible

translated_title: 语言模型在串行需求下如何以不同方式重新分配注意力头活动
translated_abstract: 模型在每一层注意力头上分配活动的方式，为观察它如何在深度方向上路由信息提供了一个粗略视角；而这种分配方式如何随任务变化，是机制性解释需要阐明的一部分。在保持提示长度不变的情况下，我们改变任务所需的串行步骤数量，并在17个开源权重模型的每一层中测量：随着需求上升，活动是集中在少数几个注意力头上，还是分散到许多注意力头上。两种情况都会发生：在大多数模型中，接近中层的层会集中活动，而后面的层则将其分散。不同模型在发生的位置和强度上存在差异。例如，从0.5B到7B的Qwen2.5基础模型在每项任务中的分散程度都低于平均水平，并在其网络后半部分的部分层中集中活动，而1B到8B的Llama模型和OLMo-2则在相同位置分散活动；这种对比在层数和注意力头数完全相同的Llama-3.1-70B与Qwen2.5-72B之间也基本成立。这些差异是可复现的。
tldr: 该研究通过在17个开源模型中测量各层注意力头活动的集中与分散模式，发现不同模型家族在应对串行任务需求时重新分配注意力活动的位置和强度存在显著且可复现的差异。
en_tdlr: The study measures how 17 open-weight models redistribute attention-head activity across layers under varying serial task demands, revealing reproducible differences between model families in where and how strongly activity concentrates versus spreads.
